paite: Huai nung in Jakob apai zel a, suahlam mite gam atungta hi.
heading: Jakob, Laban Inn Atung
english: Then Jacob went on his journey, and came to the land of the children of the east.

paite: Huan a-etleh ngai in, gamlak ah tuileh ana om a, akiang ah belamhon thum akual uhi. Huai tuileh a kipan belamhonte, tui adawnsak uhi. Tuileh kong a suang om alian mahmah hi.
english: He looked, and saw a well in the field, and saw three flocks of sheep lying there by it. For out of that well they watered the flocks. The stone on the well’s mouth was large.

paite: Huai ah belamhon tengteng apaikhawm ua; tuileh kong a kipan suang akhuksuan ua, tuileh kong a, a-omna ngei ah suang akoih nawn uhi.
english: There all the flocks were gathered. They rolled the stone from the well’s mouth, and watered the sheep, and put the stone back on the well’s mouth in its place.

paite: Jakob in akiang uah, "Ka unaute aw, koilam mi na hi ua?” achi hi. Amau, "Haran khomi ka hi uh," achi uh.
english: Jacob said to them, “My relatives, where are you from?” They said, “We are from Haran.”

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Nahor tapa Laban na thei kha uhia?" achi a; amau, "Thei e,” achi uhi.
english: He said to them, “Do you know Laban, the son of Nahor?” They said, “We know him.”

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Dam lai ahi na maw?" achi a; amau, "Dam lai mah e, en in, atanu, Rakil leng belamte pi ding in ahong kuan," achi uhi.
english: He said to them, “Is it well with him?” They said, “It is well. See, Rachel, his daughter, is coming with the sheep.”

paite: Ama'n, "Ngai un, ni asang lai mahmah ngal a, ganhonte pikhawm leng ahun nai kei. Belamte tui dawnsak unla, va khah lai un," achi hi.
english: He said, “Behold, it is still the middle of the day, not time to gather the livestock together. Water the sheep, and go and feed them.”

paite: Amau, "Ka hihthei kei ding uh, belamhon tengteng apikhawm ua, tuileh kong a kipan suang a khuksuan mateng uh. Huai khit chiang in belamte tui ka dawnsak zel uh," achi uhi.
english: They said, “We can’t, until all the flocks are gathered together, and they roll the stone from the well’s mouth. Then we will water the sheep.”

paite: Amau ahoupih lai in Rakil, apa belamte toh ahong tung a; ama'n huai belamte achin zel ahi.
english: While he was yet speaking with them, Rachel came with her father’s sheep, for she kept them.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Jakob in anu sanggampa Laban tanu Rakil leh anu sanggampa Laban belamhon amuh in ava naih a, tuileh kong a kipan suang akhuksuan a, anu sanggampa belamte tui adawnsak hi.
english: When Jacob saw Rachel the daughter of Laban, his mother’s brother, and the sheep of Laban, his mother’s brother, Jacob went near, and rolled the stone from the well’s mouth, and watered the flock of Laban his mother’s brother.

paite: Jakob in Rakil atawp a, ngaihtak in akapta hi.
english: Jacob kissed Rachel, and lifted up his voice, and wept.

paite: Jakob in apa tanau nai leh Rebekah tapa ahihdan Rakil ahilh hi. Rakil atai a, apa ava hilhta hi.
english: Jacob told Rachel that he was her father’s relative, and that he was Rebekah’s son. She ran and told her father.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Laban in asanggamnu tapa Jakob tanchin azaktak in, amah dawn ding in atai a, apom a, atawp a, a-inn ah apita hi. Jakob in hiai thu tengteng Laban ahilh hi.
english: When Laban heard the news of Jacob, his sister’s son, he ran to meet Jacob, and embraced him, and kissed him, and brought him to his house. Jacob told Laban all these things.

paite: Laban in akiang ah, "Ka guh mah leh ka sa mah na hi,” achi hi. Huchi in akiang ah kha khat ataam hi.
english: Laban said to him, “Surely you are my bone and my flesh.” Jacob stayed with him for a month.

paite: Huan Laban in Jakob kiang ah, "Ka tupa na hih ziak in amawk in ka nna na sem dia hia? Bang na loh dia? Hon hilh in," achi hi.
heading: Rakil Leh Leah Loh Ding In Jakob In Laban Nna Asem
english: Laban said to Jacob, “Because you are my relative, should you therefore serve me for nothing? Tell me, what will your wages be?”

paite: Laban in tanu nih anei a; a-upazaw min Leah ahi a, anaupangzaw min Rakil ahi.
english: Laban had two daughters. The name of the elder was Leah, and the name of the younger was Rachel.

paite: Leah mit anou a, Rakil bel chinou hoihtak ahi a, amel leng ahoih mahmah hi.
english: Leah’s eyes were weak, but Rachel was beautiful in form and attractive.

paite: Jakob in Rakil a-it a, "Na tanu naupangzaw Rakil toh kiteng ding in kum sagih nang nna ka hon sepsak ding," achi hi.
english: Jacob loved Rachel. He said, “I will serve you seven years for Rachel, your younger daughter.”

paite: Laban in, “Amah ahihleh midang kiang a ka piak sang in nang kiang a ka piak mah ahoihzaw ve. Ka kiang ah om nilouh in," achi hi.
english: Laban said, “It is better that I give her to you, than that I should give her to another man. Stay with me.”

paite: Jakob in Rakil kitenpih ding in kum sagih a-nna asepsakta hi. Himahleh Rakil a-it mahmah ziak in ni tam lou chik bang in athei hi.
english: Jacob served seven years for Rachel. They seemed to him but a few days, for the love he had for her.

paite: Jakob in Laban kiang ah, "Ka kithuahpih theihna ding in ka zi hon peta in, ka hun lah akimta ngal a," achi hi.
english: Jacob said to Laban, “Give me my wife, for my days are fulfilled, that I may go in to her.”

paite: Laban in huai khua a mi tengteng akaikhawm vek a, ankuang alui hi.
english: Laban gathered together all the men of the place, and made a feast.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, khomial tung in atanu Leah api a, Jakob kiang ah apilut a; ama'n ana kithuahpih hi.
english: In the evening, he took Leah his daughter, and brought her to Jacob. He went in to her.

paite: Laban in atanu Leah kiang ah asikhanu ding in ama sikhanu Zilpah apia hi.
english: Laban gave Zilpah his servant to his daughter Leah for a servant.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, zingsang ahong hih in, ngai in, Leah ana hi maimah hi. Jakob in Laban kiang ah, "Ka tung a na thilhih bangchidan ahia? Rakil toh kiteng ding a na nna sem ka ahi kei maw? Bangziak a hon khem maimah na hia?" achi hi.
english: In the morning, behold, it was Leah! He said to Laban, “What is this you have done to me? Didn’t I serve with you for Rachel? Why then have you deceived me?”

paite: Laban in, "Ka gam uah huchibang a ta upazaw ma a anauzaw piak ngeina ahi kei.
english: Laban said, “It is not done so in our place, to give the younger before the firstborn.

paite: Hiai minu' nipikal zou phot inla, huchi in kum sagih dang ka nna na sep zoh chiang in anauzaw leng ka hon pe ding," achi hi.
english: Fulfill the week of this one, and we will give you the other also for the service which you will serve with me for seven more years.”

paite: Jakob in huchibang in ahih a, anipikal azouta a; atanu Rakil azi ding in apeta hi.
english: Jacob did so, and fulfilled her week. He gave him Rachel his daughter as wife.

paite: Laban in atanu Rakil kiang ah asikhanu ding in ama sikhanu Bilhah apia hi.
english: Laban gave Bilhah, his servant, to his daughter Rachel to be her servant.

paite: Rakil leng akithuahpih a, Leah sang in Rakil a-itzawa, Laban nna kum sagih dang asemta hi.
english: He went in also to Rachel, and he loved also Rachel more than Leah, and served with him seven more years.

paite: TOUPA'N Leah pen huat in a-om chih athei a, asul ahonsak a; Rakil bel achiing hi.
heading: Jakob Tate
english: Yahweh saw that Leah was hated, and he opened her womb, but Rachel was barren.

paite: Leah agai a, tapa anei a, amin Reuben asa hi. "TOUPA'N ka gimdan amuta. Tu'n zaw ka pasal in hon itta ding, " achi hi.
english: Leah conceived, and bore a son, and she named him Reuben. For she said, “Because Yahweh has looked at my affliction; for now my husband will love me.”

paite: Agai nawn a, tapa anei nawn a, “TOUPA'N huat a ka om azak ziak in hiai leng ahon pia hi,” achi hi. Huchi in amin Simeon asa hi.
english: She conceived again, and bore a son, and said, “Because Yahweh has heard that I am hated, he has therefore given me this son also.” She named him Simeon.

paite: Agai nawn a, tapa anei nawn a, "Tu in tapa thum ka neihsak ziak in, ka pasal in hon zuita ding, achi hi. Huaiziak in amin Levi asa hi.
english: She conceived again, and bore a son. She said, “Now this time my husband will be joined to me, because I have borne him three sons.” Therefore his name was called Levi.

paite: Agai nawn a, tapa anei nawn a, "Tutung in zaw TOUPA ka phat ding," achi hi. Huaiziak in amin Judah asa a; ta anei nawn tadih kei hi.
english: She conceived again, and bore a son. She said, “This time I will praise Yahweh.” Therefore she named him Judah. Then she stopped bearing.
